parsed.notes:
Qualifications & Skills is required; Preferred Qualifications is optional. Technologies appearing only in responsibilities or company description are excluded.
AI/ML engineering is read literally as naming both AI/ML and ML engineering.
General model optimization is not assumed to mean inference optimization. RLHF is not equated with fine-tuning or generic reinforcement learning alone.
Unmapped entries preserve specifically named technical methods and technologies absent from the taxonomy; they inherit the requirement status of their source section.
Distributed training and computer vision remain required because they are independently required, despite their optional framework examples and specialist variants.
Degree fields, startup experience, publication history, soft skills, and safety-critical application-domain experience are not treated as technical skills.
